resolved_findings.resolution: All six Graph temporal values are parsed once as timezone-aware UTC ISO-8601 values before any write. Required unknown/invalid times fail closed; optional nulls remain null. EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE uses an exact null-safe CASE WHEN parameter IS NULL THEN null ELSE datetime(parameter) END expression for published, retrieved, filed, effective-from, effective-to and materialized times. No current-time substitution exists.

GraphDocument now carries explicit write_mode and provenance. Only write_mode=legacy plus provenance=legacy_explicit enters legacy aggregate MERGE. Temporal, V2-origin, unknown-provenance and quarantined documents are validated before entity/relation work; incomplete inputs are skipped with sanitized lifecycle code/count and zero write calls.

GraphDocument carries canonical Stage03 materialization provenance from document metadata or the Stage03 ingested_at value, with no now fallback. materialized_at is required for temporal V2 writes, normalized, persisted as a Neo4j DateTime on EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE, and remains unchanged on deterministic retry.

write_boundary.legacy: Allowed only for explicit write_mode=legacy and provenance=legacy_explicit.
write_boundary.temporal_v2: Requires Stage03 provenance, every immutable identity, known publication/retrieval/effective-start/materialization time, valid optional times and non-quarantined state.
write_boundary.rejection: Rejected documents perform no entity or relation write, increment skipped/rejected lifecycle counts and expose only stable sanitized rejection codes.

temporal_property_contract.neo4j_type_conversion: Null-safe datetime(parameter) on EvidenceObservationV2 ON CREATE.
temporal_property_contract.idempotent_materialized_at: Create-only; identical evidence retry preserves the original value.
